### 5. Production DDL Schema & Relational Integrity

The relational schema decouples tasks from historical attempts, preserves lineage hashes, and provides normalized indices for hot reconciliation paths.

```sql
-- migrations/0001_init_repo_bot.sql

-- Transport Ingress Deduplication (Authoritative Edge Registry)
CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys (
  scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  delivery_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('RECEIVED', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED')) NOT NULL,
  handler_lease_expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  response_payload TEXT,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error TEXT,
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope, delivery_key)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_idempotency_lease ON idempotency_keys(status, handler_lease_expires_at_ms);

-- Immutable Task Specifications
CREATE TABLE tasks (
  task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  contract_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_repo TEXT NOT NULL,
  scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  shot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  current_attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  current_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_whitelist_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  forbidden_patterns_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK(max_attempts >= 1),
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Historical Attempt Audit Trail (1:N)
CREATE TABLE task_attempts (
  attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_number >= 1),
  branch_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  base_commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  head_sha TEXT,
  pr_number INTEGER,
  last_projected_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN (
    'PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'VERIFYING', 'SCOPE_PASSED',
    'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 'MERGING', 'MERGED', 'RETRYING', 
    'ROLLING_BACK', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'DLQ', 'HALTED'
  )) NOT NULL,
  exit_reason TEXT,
  failure_diagnostic_json TEXT,
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
  UNIQUE(task_id, attempt_number)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_attempts_task_status ON task_attempts(task_id, status);
CREATE INDEX idx_attempts_branch ON task_attempts(branch_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_attempts_head_sha ON task_attempts(head_sha);

-- Append-Only System Audit Log
CREATE TABLE task_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_state TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT,
  epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  diagnostic_json TEXT,
  emitted_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_task ON task_events(task_id, emitted_at_ms);

-- One-Shot Approval Ledger
CREATE TABLE approvals (
  approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  decided_by TEXT,
  decision TEXT CHECK(decision IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'TIMEOUT')),
  decided_at_ms INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
  UNIQUE(task_id, head_sha)
);

-- System Flags & Kill Switches
CREATE TABLE system_flags (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Stratified Operational Cost Telemetry
CREATE TABLE operational_telemetry (
  telemetry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  contract_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  manifest_id TEXT,
  shot_class TEXT CHECK(shot_class IN ('CLOSE_UP', 'MEDIUM_SHOT', 'WIDE_ESTABLISHING', 'SURGICAL_INPAINT')) NOT NULL,
  resolution TEXT CHECK(resolution IN ('720P', '1080P', '4K')) NOT NULL,
  compute_tier TEXT CHECK(compute_tier IN ('LOCAL_RIG2', 'SERVERLESS_RUNPOD', 'CPU_SPECIALIST')) NOT NULL,
  tokens_consumed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  gpu_seconds REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
  cap_charged_usd REAL NOT NULL CHECK(cap_charged_usd >= 0.0),
  estimated_actual_usd REAL NOT NULL CHECK(estimated_actual_usd >= 0.0),
  terminal_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  executed_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_telemetry_stratified ON operational_telemetry(shot_class, resolution, compute_tier);

-- Shadow Mode Violation Analysis
CREATE TABLE shadow_violations (
  violation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  rule_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  rule_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  violating_span TEXT NOT NULL,
  hypothetical_action TEXT CHECK(hypothetical_action IN ('WOULD_ROLLBACK', 'WOULD_BLOCK_MERGE')) NOT NULL,
  human_disposition TEXT CHECK(human_disposition IN ('UNREVIEWED', 'TRUE_POSITIVE', 'FALSE_POSITIVE', 'AMBIGUOUS')) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNREVIEWED',
  reviewed_by TEXT,
  reviewed_at_ms INTEGER,
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_shadow_disposition ON shadow_violations(human_disposition);
```

### 6. The Outbox Executor, Quality Ingestion, & SHA-Pinned Merge

#### The Outbox Executor (`src/services/outboxExecutor.ts`)

```typescript
export async function drainTaskOutbox(env: Env, coordinator: DurableObjectStub): Promise<void> {
  const pendingActions = await coordinator.getPendingOutboxActions();

  for (const action of pendingActions) {
    try {
      switch (action.type) {
        case 'D1_PROJECTION_UPDATE':
          await env.DB.batch([
            env.DB.prepare(`
              INSERT INTO task_attempts (
                attempt_id, task_id, attempt_number, branch_name, base_commit_sha, 
                last_projected_epoch, status, exit_reason, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms
              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
              ON CONFLICT(task_id, attempt_number) DO UPDATE SET
                status = excluded.status,
                last_projected_epoch = excluded.last_projected_epoch,
                exit_reason = excluded.exit_reason,
                updated_at_ms = excluded.updated_at_ms
            `).bind(
              `${action.payload.taskId}:${action.payload.attempt}`,
              action.payload.taskId,
              action.payload.attempt,
              action.payload.branchName || 'unknown',
              action.payload.baseCommitSha || 'unknown',
              action.payload.epoch,
              action.payload.state,
              action.payload.reason,
              Date.now(),
              Date.now()
            ),
            env.DB.prepare(`
              UPDATE tasks SET current_status = ?, current_attempt_number = ? WHERE task_id = ?
            `).bind(action.payload.state, action.payload.attempt, action.payload.taskId)
          ]);
          break;

        case 'GITHUB_COMPENSATING_ACTIONS':
          const octokit = new Octokit({ auth: await getInstallationToken(env, 'studio-owner', action.payload.targetRepo) });
          // Idempotent PR closure
          if (action.payload.prNumber) {
            try {
              await octokit.pulls.update({
                owner: 'studio-owner',
                repo: action.payload.targetRepo,
                pull_number: action.payload.prNumber,
                state: 'closed'
              });
            } catch (err: any) {
              if (err.status !== 404 && err.status !== 422) throw err;
            }
          }
          // Idempotent branch deletion
          try {
            await octokit.git.deleteRef({
              owner: 'studio-owner',
              repo: action.payload.targetRepo,
              ref: `heads/${action.payload.branchName.replace(/^refs\/heads\//, '')}`
            });
          } catch (err: any) {
            if (err.status !== 404 && err.status !== 422) throw err;
          }
          break;

        case 'GITHUB_EXECUTE_MERGE':
          await executeShaPinnedMerge(env, action.payload);
          break;

        case 'GLOBAL_BUDGET_SETTLE':
          const globalCoordinator = env.GLOBAL_COORDINATOR.get(env.GLOBAL_COORDINATOR.idFromName('GLOBAL_SINGLETON'));
          await globalCoordinator.settleBudgetReservation(action.payload.dedupeKey, action.payload.state);
          break;
      }

      await coordinator.markOutboxActionCompleted(action.id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      await coordinator.recordOutboxActionFailure(action.id, err.message);
      break; // Preserve causal ordering on failure
    }
  }
}

```

#### Quality Ingestion & SHA-Pinned Merge

```typescript
// Ingestion: routes by branch/task, not projected state
export async function handleCheckRunCompleted(env: Env, payload: any): Promise<void> {
  if (payload.check_run.name !== 'repo-bot/quality-gauntlet') return;

  const headBranch = payload.check_run.check_suite.head_branch;
  const headSha = payload.check_run.head_sha;
  const conclusion = payload.check_run.conclusion; // 'success' | 'failure'

  // Extract task ID deterministically from branch name
  const taskMatch = headBranch.match(/^spec\/(task-[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{2})?)-/i);
  if (!taskMatch) return;

  const taskId = taskMatch[1].toUpperCase();
  const coordinator = env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.get(env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.idFromName(taskId));

  if (conclusion === 'success') {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('QUALITY_PASS', { type: 'AUDIT_ENGINE' });
  } else {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('QUALITY_FAIL_RETRY', { type: 'AUDIT_ENGINE' }, {
      diagnostic: 'Test gauntlet assertion failed'
    });
  }
}

// Execution: asserts latest check run per name
export async function executeShaPinnedMerge(env: Env, payload: {
  taskId: string;
  prNumber: number;
  expectedSha: string;
  targetRepo: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const octokit = new Octokit({ auth: await getInstallationToken(env, 'studio-owner', payload.targetRepo) });
  const coordinator = env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.get(env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.idFromName(payload.taskId));

  // 1. Verify PR head commit has not moved
  const pr = await octokit.pulls.get({
    owner: 'studio-owner',
    repo: payload.targetRepo,
    pull_number: payload.prNumber
  });

  if (pr.data.head.sha !== payload.expectedSha) {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_FAILED', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, {
      error: `HEAD_MOVED: Expected ${payload.expectedSha}, found ${pr.data.head.sha}`
    });
    return;
  }

  // 2. Fetch paginated check runs and resolve the LATEST run per name
  const checkRuns = await octokit.paginate(octokit.checks.listForRef, {
    owner: 'studio-owner',
    repo: payload.targetRepo,
    ref: payload.expectedSha
  });

  const latestRuns = new Map<string, { conclusion: string; completed_at: string }>();
  for (const run of checkRuns) {
    const existing = latestRuns.get(run.name);
    if (!existing || new Date(run.completed_at!).getTime() > new Date(existing.completed_at).getTime()) {
      latestRuns.set(run.name, { conclusion: run.conclusion!, completed_at: run.completed_at! });
    }
  }

  const scopeOk = latestRuns.get('repo-bot/scope-check')?.conclusion === 'success';
  const qualityOk = latestRuns.get('repo-bot/quality-gauntlet')?.conclusion === 'success';

  if (!scopeOk || !qualityOk) {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_FAILED', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, {
      error: 'PRECONDITION_FAILED: Latest check runs are not green'
    });
    return;
  }

  // 3. Execute SHA-pinned squash merge
  try {
    await octokit.pulls.merge({
      owner: 'studio-owner',
      repo: payload.targetRepo,
      pull_number: payload.prNumber,
      sha: payload.expectedSha,
      merge_method: 'squash'
    });
    await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_SUCCEEDED', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_FAILED', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, { error: err.message });
  }
}

```

### 7. Pragmatic Testing & Verification Architecture

#### The FSM Property-Test Suite (`tests/fsm.property.test.ts`)

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { 
  TaskState, FSMEvent, TRANSITION_TABLE, evaluateTransition, FSMContext, AuthenticatedActor 
} from '../src/fsm/transitions';

describe('FSM Graph Verification & Safety Invariants', () => {
  const allStates: TaskState[] = [
    'PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'VERIFYING', 'SCOPE_PASSED',
    'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 'MERGING', 'MERGED', 'RETRYING', 
    'ROLLING_BACK', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'DLQ', 'HALTED'
  ];

  const terminalStates: TaskState[] = ['MERGED', 'DLQ'];
  const nonTerminalStates = allStates.filter(s => !terminalStates.includes(s));

  const baseContext: FSMContext = {
    taskId: 'TASK-01.01',
    currentEpoch: 1,
    attemptCount: 1,
    maxAttempts: 3,
    isHighRiskPath: false,
    scopeCheckPassed: true,
    qualityCheckPassed: true,
    auditedHeadSha: 'sha-root-1',
    candidateHeadSha: 'sha-root-1',
    branchName: 'spec/task-01.01-attempt1',
    prNumber: 42,
    targetRepo: 'worker-sower-engine',
    baseCommitSha: 'sha-base'
  };

  it('Property 1: Non-terminal states (excluding uninterruptible states) must support emergency halt', () => {
    // MERGING and ROLLING_BACK execute atomic compensating sagas and cannot be halted mid-flight
    const haltableStates = nonTerminalStates.filter(s => !['HALTED', 'MERGING', 'ROLLING_BACK', 'ROLLED_BACK'].includes(s));

    for (const state of haltableStates) {
      const result = evaluateTransition(state, 'KILL_SWITCH_TRIP', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, baseContext);
      expect(result.nextState).toBe('HALTED');
    }
  });

  it('Property 2: Graph Reachability Safety - All paths to MERGED must traverse SCOPE_PASSED and MERGING', () => {
    // Build adjacency list excluding SCOPE_PASSED
    const adjWithoutScope = new Map<TaskState, Set<TaskState>>();
    for (const rule of TRANSITION_TABLE) {
      if (rule.from === 'SCOPE_PASSED' || rule.to === 'SCOPE_PASSED') continue;
      const targets = adjWithoutScope.get(rule.from) || new Set();
      targets.add(rule.to);
      adjWithoutScope.set(rule.from, targets);
    }

    // BFS search from PENDING
    const visited = new Set<TaskState>();
    const queue: TaskState[] = ['PENDING'];
    while (queue.length > 0) {
      const curr = queue.shift()!;
      visited.add(curr);
      for (const next of adjWithoutScope.get(curr) || []) {
        if (!visited.has(next)) queue.push(next);
      }
    }

    expect(visited.has('MERGED')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('Property 3: Graph Reachability Liveness - Every non-terminal state can reach a terminal state', () => {
    // Build complete adjacency list assuming guards are satisfiable
    const adj = new Map<TaskState, Set<TaskState>>();
    for (const rule of TRANSITION_TABLE) {
      const targets = adj.get(rule.from) || new Set();
      targets.add(rule.to);
      adj.set(rule.from, targets);
    }

    for (const state of nonTerminalStates) {
      const visited = new Set<TaskState>();
      const queue: TaskState[] = [state];
      let canReachTerminal = false;

      while (queue.length > 0) {
        const curr = queue.shift()!;
        if (terminalStates.includes(curr)) {
          canReachTerminal = true;
          break;
        }
        visited.add(curr);
        for (const next of adj.get(curr) || []) {
          if (!visited.has(next)) queue.push(next);
        }
      }

      expect(canReachTerminal, `Liveness failure: State '${state}' has no path to MERGED or DLQ`).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('Property 4: Guard Determinism - Rules sharing (from, event) must mutually partition the context', () => {
    const grouped = new Map<string, typeof TRANSITION_TABLE>();
    for (const rule of TRANSITION_TABLE) {
      const key = `${rule.from}:${rule.event}`;
      const existing = grouped.get(key) || [];
      existing.push(rule);
      grouped.set(key, existing);
    }

    // Context testing contexts across attempt limits and risk classes
    const testCases: FSMContext[] = [
      { ...baseContext, attemptCount: 1, maxAttempts: 3, isHighRiskPath: false },
      { ...baseContext, attemptCount: 3, maxAttempts: 3, isHighRiskPath: false },
      { ...baseContext, attemptCount: 1, maxAttempts: 3, isHighRiskPath: true },
      { ...baseContext, attemptCount: 3, maxAttempts: 3, isHighRiskPath: true },
      { ...baseContext, auditedHeadSha: 'sha-1', candidateHeadSha: 'sha-2' } // Moved head
    ];

    const actors: AuthenticatedActor[] = [
      { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' },
      { type: 'AUDIT_ENGINE' },
      { type: 'LEAD_ARCHITECT', userId: 'usr_admin' },
      { type: 'REMOTE_WORKER', workerId: 'wrk_1', epoch: 1 }
    ];

    for (const [key, rules] of grouped) {
      if (rules.length <= 1) continue;

      for (const ctx of testCases) {
        for (const actor of actors) {
          const matching = rules.filter(r => {
            const actorOk = r.authorizedActorTypes.includes(actor.type);
            const guardOk = r.guard ? r.guard(ctx) : true;
            return actorOk && guardOk;
          });

          expect(
            matching.length,
            `Ambiguity detected on ${key} for actor ${actor.type}. Matches: ${matching.length}`
          ).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  it('Property 5: Terminal State Idempotency - MERGED and DLQ return no-op on duplicate events', () => {
    const allEvents: FSMEvent[] = [
      'LEASE_CLAIMED', 'WORKER_ACK', 'SUBMIT_VERIFY', 'SCOPE_PASS', 'QUALITY_PASS',
      'WATCHDOG_EXPIRE', 'KILL_SWITCH_TRIP', 'HUMAN_APPROVE'
    ];

    for (const termState of terminalStates) {
      for (const ev of allEvents) {
        const result = evaluateTransition(termState, ev, { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, baseContext);
        expect(result.isNoop).toBe(true);
        expect(result.nextState).toBe(termState);
      }
    }
  });
});
```

The system specification is finalized. Structural constraints, typed schemas, and single-owner Durable Objects replace unverified operational claims. The immediate deliverable is executing Phase 1: running the automated FSM property-test harness against the transition matrix.### 1. Epistemic Foundations & The Boundary of Authority

The Deletion Principle establishes a strict partition between what is model-independent and what is archive-dependent:

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        THE DELETION PRINCIPLE                          │
├──────────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1. THE NARRATIVE LEDGER          │ 2. THE MEDIA ARCHIVE                │
│ (Model-Independent Reality)      │ (Archive-Dependent Artifacts)       │
├──────────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────┤
│ • Canon entities, facts, state   │ • Latent video plates, keyed alpha  │
│   vectors, and dependency graphs.│   WebMs, and synthesized WAV stems. │
│ • Stored in relational SQLite/D1.│ • Stored in content-addressed R2.   │
│ • Consistent with respect to its │ • Irreplaceable: non-deterministic  │
│   explicitly declared rules.     │   CUDA/sampling cannot reproduce it.│
│ • Survives the total destruction │ • Requires active scrubbing and     │
│   of all machine learning models.│   cold restore validation drills.   │
└──────────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────┘

```

The relational ledger's consistency is strictly bounded by the rules programmed into its check constraints, foreign keys, and pre-flight SAT solvers. Continuity facts not explicitly encoded as constraints remain unvalidated.

Because diffusion plates and neural audio stems cannot be regenerated bit-for-bit from seeds alone, the archive requires continuous physical maintenance:

* **Rolling Range Scrubbing:** Rather than sampling 5% with replacement (which leaves roughly 36.8% of assets unchecked over a 20-week cycle due to the $e^{-1}$ limit), the background scrubber uses a deterministic, hash-ordered cursor to verify cryptographic SHA-256 checksums across 100% of archived objects every 30 days.
* **Scheduled Cold-Restore Drills:** On the 15th of every month, an automated worker restores a historical scene assembly from raw R2 bytes into a clean isolate, compiles the Remotion composition, and confirms that frame hashes match the original broadcast manifest.

#### Authority Partitioning: Edge Ingress vs. Task Core

```text
[ INBOUND WEBHOOK / CHATOPS ]
              │
              ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ EDGE INGRESS LAYER (Authoritative: Cloudflare D1)                      │
│                                                                        │
│ • Enforces transport-level idempotency via idempotency_keys table.     │
│ • Evaluates (scope, delivery_key) with atomic primary-key conflicts.   │
│ • Owns the two-phase RECEIVED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED lifecycle.   │
│ • Executes before any Durable Object or task entity exists.            │
└─────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │ Valid & Unique
                              ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ TASK EXECUTION PLANE (Authoritative: Cloudflare Durable Objects)       │
│                                                                        │
│ • GlobalCoordinator DO: Singleton owning budget reservations & kill.   │
│ • ShotCoordinator DO: Instance per task owning lifecycle FSM & alarms. │
│ • Task State in D1: Read-only projection updated asynchronously.       │
│ • Invariant: Every gating decision reads DO state, NEVER D1.           │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

```

D1 and Durable Objects govern separate domains:

* **D1 is Authoritative for Transport Deduplication:** When a webhook arrives, no task DO may exist yet. D1 resolves delivery uniqueness atomically via `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`.
* **Durable Objects are Authoritative for Task State:** All operational decisions—whether an epoch is valid, whether a lease can be renewed, whether an attempt may merge, and whether budget is available—are read from and mutated within single-threaded Durable Object memory.
* **D1 Task Records are Projections:** D1 task tables are read-only mirrors populated via the DO's outbox. Disagreement across the network boundary is transient and repairable; the hourly reconciler detects discrepancies and brings D1 back into alignment with the DO.

### 2. The Formally Specified Finite State Machine

To eliminate premature merges, unhandled events, and skipped quality gates, the Finite State Machine (FSM) models the full lifecycle across 13 discrete states, incorporating an explicit `MERGING` stage, context-updating transitions, and error-branching logic.

```text
                                [ DISPATCH ]
                                     │
                                     ▼
                                ┌─────────┐
                      ┌────────►│ PENDING │◄────────┐
                      │         └────┬────┘         │
                      │              │ LEASE_CLAIMED│
                      │              ▼              │
                      │         ┌─────────┐         │
                      │         │ CLAIMED │         │
                      │         └────┬────┘         │
                      │              │ WORKER_ACK   │
                      │              ▼              │
                      │         ┌─────────┐         │ OPERATOR_RESUME
                      │   ┌────►│ RUNNING │         │ (From Non-Destructive Halt)
                      │   │     └────┬────┘         │
       RETRY_EXHAUSTED│   │          │ SUBMIT_VERIFY│
       (Attempts < Max│   │          ▼              │
       New Attempt)   │   │    ┌───────────┐        │
                      │   │    │ VERIFYING │◄───────┤ (NEW_HEAD_PUSHED resets
                      │   │    └─────┬─────┘        │  from SCOPE_PASSED or
                      │   │          │ SCOPE_PASS   │  AWAITING_APPROVAL)
                      │   │          ▼              │
                      │   │    ┌──────────────┐     │
                      │   │    │ SCOPE_PASSED │─────┘
                      │   │    └─────┬────────┘
                      │   │          │ QUALITY_PASS
                      │   │          ├────────────────────────┐
                      │   │          ▼ [Low-Risk]             ▼ [High-Risk]
                      │   │    ┌───────────┐        ┌──────────────────┐
                      │   │    │  MERGING  │        │AWAITING_APPROVAL │
                      │   │    └─────┬─────┘        └─────────┬────────┘
                      │   │          │                        │ HUMAN_APPROVE
                      │   │          │ MERGE_SUCCEEDED        ▼
                      │   │          │                  ┌───────────┐
                      │   │          ▼                  │  MERGING  │
                      │   │     ┌─────────┐             └─────┬─────┘
                      │   │     │ MERGED  │                   │ MERGE_SUCCEEDED
                      │   │     └─────────┘                   ▼
                      │   │                             ┌─────────┐
                      │   │                             │ MERGED  │
                      │   │ QUALITY_FAIL_RETRY          └─────────┘
                      │   │ (Attempts < Max)
                      │   │
                      │   └─────┌──────────┐
                      └─────────┤ RETRYING │
                                └──────────┘

```

#### Executable Transition Engine (`src/fsm/transitions.ts`)

```typescript
export type TaskState =
  | 'PENDING'
  | 'CLAIMED'
  | 'RUNNING'
  | 'VERIFYING'
  | 'SCOPE_PASSED'
  | 'AWAITING_APPROVAL'
  | 'MERGING'
  | 'MERGED'
  | 'RETRYING'
  | 'ROLLING_BACK'
  | 'ROLLED_BACK'
  | 'DLQ'
  | 'HALTED';

export type FSMEvent =
  | 'LEASE_CLAIMED'
  | 'WORKER_ACK'
  | 'SUBMIT_VERIFY'
  | 'SCOPE_PASS'
  | 'QUALITY_PASS'
  | 'QUALITY_FAIL_RETRY'
  | 'SECURITY_VIOLATION'
  | 'NEW_HEAD_PUSHED'
  | 'HUMAN_APPROVE'
  | 'HUMAN_REJECT'
  | 'APPROVAL_TIMEOUT'
  | 'WATCHDOG_EXPIRE'
  | 'ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT'
  | 'MERGE_TIMEOUT'
  | 'ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT'
  | 'KILL_SWITCH_TRIP'
  | 'OPERATOR_CANCEL'
  | 'OPERATOR_RESUME'
  | 'MERGE_SUCCEEDED'
  | 'MERGE_FAILED_TRANSIENT'
  | 'MERGE_FAILED_HEAD_MOVED'
  | 'MERGE_FAILED_CONFLICT'
  | 'ROLLBACK_COMPLETE'
  | 'WORKER_ABORT'
  | 'RECONCILER_EXPIRY';

export type AuthenticatedActor =
  | { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }
  | { type: 'REMOTE_WORKER'; workerId: string; epoch: number }
  | { type: 'AUDIT_ENGINE' }
  | { type: 'LEAD_ARCHITECT'; userId: string };

export interface FSMContext {
  taskId: string;
  currentEpoch: number;
  attemptCount: number;
  maxAttempts: number;
  isHighRiskPath: boolean;
  auditedHeadSha?: string;
  candidateHeadSha?: string;
  scopeCheckPassed: boolean;
  qualityCheckPassed: boolean;
  branchName: string;
  prNumber?: number;
  targetRepo: string;
  baseCommitSha: string;
  rollbackReason?: string;
}

export interface TransitionResult {
  nextState: TaskState;
  contextPatch?: Partial<FSMContext>;
  isNoop?: boolean;
}

export interface TransitionRule {
  from: TaskState;
  event: FSMEvent;
  to: TaskState;
  authorizedActorTypes: Array<AuthenticatedActor['type']>;
  guard?: (ctx: FSMContext, payload?: any) => boolean;
  producePatch?: (ctx: FSMContext, payload?: any) => Partial<FSMContext>;
}

export const TRANSITION_TABLE: TransitionRule[] = [
  // Dispatch & Worker Initialization
  { from: 'PENDING', event: 'LEASE_CLAIMED', to: 'CLAIMED', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'] },
  { from: 'CLAIMED', event: 'WORKER_ACK', to: 'RUNNING', authorizedActorTypes: ['REMOTE_WORKER'] },
  { from: 'CLAIMED', event: 'WATCHDOG_EXPIRE', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'], producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'CLAIMED_BOOT_TIMEOUT' }) },
  { from: 'CLAIMED', event: 'WORKER_ABORT', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['REMOTE_WORKER'], producePatch: (_, p) => ({ rollbackReason: p?.reason || 'WORKER_ABORT' }) },

  // Active Execution Transitions
  { 
    from: 'RUNNING', 
    event: 'SUBMIT_VERIFY', 
    to: 'VERIFYING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['REMOTE_WORKER'],
    producePatch: (_, p) => ({ candidateHeadSha: p?.headSha })
  },
  { from: 'RUNNING', event: 'WORKER_ABORT', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['REMOTE_WORKER'], producePatch: (_, p) => ({ rollbackReason: p?.reason || 'WORKER_ABORT' }) },
  { 
    from: 'RUNNING', 
    event: 'WATCHDOG_EXPIRE', 
    to: 'RETRYING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    guard: (ctx) => ctx.attemptCount < ctx.maxAttempts,
    producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'WATCHDOG_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT' })
  },
  { 
    from: 'RUNNING', 
    event: 'WATCHDOG_EXPIRE', 
    to: 'ROLLING_BACK', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    guard: (ctx) => ctx.attemptCount >= ctx.maxAttempts,
    producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'WATCHDOG_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_EXHAUSTED' })
  },
  { from: 'RUNNING', event: 'ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'], producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'TASK_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT_15M' }) },

  // Verification Gauntlet: Scope -> Quality -> Merging
  { 
    from: 'VERIFYING', 
    event: 'SCOPE_PASS', 
    to: 'SCOPE_PASSED', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    producePatch: (ctx, p) => ({ 
      scopeCheckPassed: true, 
      isHighRiskPath: p?.isHighRiskPath ?? ctx.isHighRiskPath,
      auditedHeadSha: ctx.candidateHeadSha 
    })
  },
  { from: 'VERIFYING', event: 'SECURITY_VIOLATION', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'], producePatch: (_, p) => ({ rollbackReason: p?.reason || 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' }) },
  { 
    from: 'VERIFYING', 
    event: 'NEW_HEAD_PUSHED', 
    to: 'VERIFYING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    producePatch: (_, p) => ({ candidateHeadSha: p?.headSha, scopeCheckPassed: false, qualityCheckPassed: false })
  },

  // Synchronize Events Invalidating Prior Checks
  { 
    from: 'SCOPE_PASSED', 
    event: 'NEW_HEAD_PUSHED', 
    to: 'VERIFYING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    producePatch: (_, p) => ({ candidateHeadSha: p?.headSha, scopeCheckPassed: false, qualityCheckPassed: false, auditedHeadSha: undefined })
  },
  { 
    from: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 
    event: 'NEW_HEAD_PUSHED', 
    to: 'VERIFYING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    producePatch: (_, p) => ({ candidateHeadSha: p?.headSha, scopeCheckPassed: false, qualityCheckPassed: false, auditedHeadSha: undefined })
  },

  // Quality Pass Routing: Low-Risk -> MERGING, High-Risk -> AWAITING_APPROVAL
  { 
    from: 'SCOPE_PASSED', 
    event: 'QUALITY_PASS', 
    to: 'MERGING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    guard: (ctx) => !ctx.isHighRiskPath && ctx.scopeCheckPassed,
    producePatch: () => ({ qualityCheckPassed: true })
  },
  { 
    from: 'SCOPE_PASSED', 
    event: 'QUALITY_PASS', 
    to: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    guard: (ctx) => ctx.isHighRiskPath && ctx.scopeCheckPassed,
    producePatch: () => ({ qualityCheckPassed: true })
  },
  { 
    from: 'SCOPE_PASSED', 
    event: 'QUALITY_FAIL_RETRY', 
    to: 'RETRYING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    guard: (ctx) => ctx.attemptCount < ctx.maxAttempts,
    producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'QUALITY_GAUNTLET_FAILED' })
  },
  { 
    from: 'SCOPE_PASSED', 
    event: 'QUALITY_FAIL_RETRY', 
    to: 'ROLLING_BACK', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'],
    guard: (ctx) => ctx.attemptCount >= ctx.maxAttempts,
    producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'QUALITY_GAUNTLET_FAILED_EXHAUSTED' })
  },
  { from: 'SCOPE_PASSED', event: 'SECURITY_VIOLATION', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'], producePatch: (_, p) => ({ rollbackReason: p?.reason || 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' }) },

  // Human Gate
  { 
    from: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 
    event: 'HUMAN_APPROVE', 
    to: 'MERGING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['LEAD_ARCHITECT'],
    guard: (ctx, p) => 
      ctx.auditedHeadSha !== undefined &&
      ctx.candidateHeadSha !== undefined &&
      ctx.auditedHeadSha === ctx.candidateHeadSha &&
      (p?.approvedHeadSha === undefined || p?.approvedHeadSha === ctx.auditedHeadSha) &&
      ctx.qualityCheckPassed && 
      ctx.scopeCheckPassed
  },
  { from: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', event: 'HUMAN_REJECT', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['LEAD_ARCHITECT'], producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'HUMAN_ARCHITECT_REJECTED' }) },
  { from: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', event: 'APPROVAL_TIMEOUT', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'], producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'APPROVAL_WINDOW_EXPIRED_24H' }) },
  { from: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', event: 'SECURITY_VIOLATION', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE'], producePatch: (_, p) => ({ rollbackReason: p?.reason || 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' }) },

  // Merge Execution Stage & Failure Categorization
  { from: 'MERGING', event: 'MERGE_SUCCEEDED', to: 'MERGED', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'] },
  { 
    from: 'MERGING', 
    event: 'MERGE_FAILED_TRANSIENT', 
    to: 'MERGING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL']
  },
  { 
    from: 'MERGING', 
    event: 'MERGE_FAILED_HEAD_MOVED', 
    to: 'VERIFYING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    producePatch: () => ({ scopeCheckPassed: false, qualityCheckPassed: false, auditedHeadSha: undefined })
  },
  { 
    from: 'MERGING', 
    event: 'MERGE_FAILED_CONFLICT', 
    to: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'GIT_MERGE_CONFLICT' })
  },
  { from: 'MERGING', event: 'SECURITY_VIOLATION', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'], producePatch: (_, p) => ({ rollbackReason: p?.reason || 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' }) },
  { from: 'MERGING', event: 'MERGE_TIMEOUT', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'], producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'MERGE_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT' }) },

  // Retry Progression
  { from: 'RETRYING', event: 'SECURITY_VIOLATION', to: 'ROLLING_BACK', authorizedActorTypes: ['AUDIT_ENGINE', 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL'], producePatch: (_, p) => ({ rollbackReason: p?.reason || 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' }) },
  { 
    from: 'RETRYING', 
    event: 'LEASE_CLAIMED', 
    to: 'CLAIMED', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    producePatch: (ctx) => ({ 
      attemptCount: ctx.attemptCount + 1,
      branchName: `spec/${ctx.taskId.toLowerCase()}-attempt${ctx.attemptCount + 1}-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`,
      candidateHeadSha: undefined,
      auditedHeadSha: undefined,
      scopeCheckPassed: false,
      qualityCheckPassed: false
    })
  },

  // Rollback Progression
  { from: 'ROLLING_BACK', event: 'ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT', to: 'DLQ', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'], producePatch: () => ({ rollbackReason: 'ROLLBACK_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT' }) },
  { 
    from: 'ROLLING_BACK', 
    event: 'ROLLBACK_COMPLETE', 
    to: 'DLQ', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    guard: (ctx) => ctx.rollbackReason === 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' || ctx.attemptCount >= ctx.maxAttempts
  },
  { 
    from: 'ROLLING_BACK', 
    event: 'ROLLBACK_COMPLETE', 
    to: 'ROLLED_BACK', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    guard: (ctx) => ctx.rollbackReason !== 'SECURITY_VIOLATION' && ctx.attemptCount < ctx.maxAttempts
  },
  { from: 'ROLLED_BACK', event: 'RECONCILER_EXPIRY', to: 'DLQ', authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL'] },
  { 
    from: 'ROLLED_BACK', 
    event: 'OPERATOR_RESUME', 
    to: 'PENDING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['LEAD_ARCHITECT', 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL'],
    producePatch: (ctx) => ({ 
      attemptCount: ctx.attemptCount + 1,
      branchName: `spec/${ctx.taskId.toLowerCase()}-attempt${ctx.attemptCount + 1}-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`,
      candidateHeadSha: undefined,
      auditedHeadSha: undefined,
      scopeCheckPassed: false,
      qualityCheckPassed: false
    })
  },

  // Emergency Halt: Valid from every active, non-terminal state (excluding uninterruptible sagas)
  ...(['PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'VERIFYING', 'SCOPE_PASSED', 'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 'RETRYING'] as TaskState[]).flatMap(state => [
    { from: state, event: 'KILL_SWITCH_TRIP' as FSMEvent, to: 'HALTED' as TaskState, authorizedActorTypes: ['SYSTEM_INTERNAL' as const, 'LEAD_ARCHITECT' as const] },
    { from: state, event: 'OPERATOR_CANCEL' as FSMEvent, to: 'HALTED' as TaskState, authorizedActorTypes: ['LEAD_ARCHITECT' as const] }
  ]),
  { 
    from: 'HALTED', 
    event: 'OPERATOR_RESUME', 
    to: 'PENDING', 
    authorizedActorTypes: ['LEAD_ARCHITECT'],
    producePatch: (ctx) => ({ 
      attemptCount: ctx.attemptCount + 1,
      branchName: `spec/${ctx.taskId.toLowerCase()}-attempt${ctx.attemptCount + 1}-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`,
      candidateHeadSha: undefined,
      auditedHeadSha: undefined,
      scopeCheckPassed: false,
      qualityCheckPassed: false
    })
  }
];

// Startup verification against duplicate state/event definitions
const TRANSITION_MAP = new Map<string, TransitionRule[]>();
for (const rule of TRANSITION_TABLE) {
  const key = `${rule.from}:${rule.event}`;
  const existing = TRANSITION_MAP.get(key) || [];
  existing.push(rule);
  TRANSITION_MAP.set(key, existing);
}

export function evaluateTransition(
  currentState: TaskState,
  event: FSMEvent,
  actor: AuthenticatedActor,
  ctx: FSMContext,
  payload?: any
): TransitionResult {
  // Idempotent No-Op on Terminal States for Late/Duplicate Webhooks
  if (['MERGED', 'DLQ'].includes(currentState)) {
    return { nextState: currentState, isNoop: true };
  }

  const rules = TRANSITION_MAP.get(`${currentState}:${event}`);
  if (!rules || rules.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`ILLEGAL_FSM_TRANSITION: Event '${event}' is not permitted from state '${currentState}'.`);
  }

  const matchingRules = rules.filter(r => {
    const actorAuthorized = r.authorizedActorTypes.includes(actor.type);
    const guardPassed = r.guard ? r.guard(ctx, payload) : true;
    return actorAuthorized && guardPassed;
  });

  if (matchingRules.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`UNAUTHORIZED_OR_GUARD_FAILED: Transition '${currentState}' via '${event}' rejected for actor '${actor.type}'.`);
  }

  if (matchingRules.length > 1) {
    throw new Error(`AMBIGUOUS_TRANSITION_ERROR: Multiple rules matched for '${currentState}' via '${event}'. Guards must partition context.`);
  }

  const selectedRule = matchingRules[0];
  const patch = selectedRule.producePatch ? selectedRule.producePatch(ctx, payload) : undefined;

  return { nextState: selectedRule.to, contextPatch: patch };
}

```

---

### 3. The State Choke Point, Heartbeat Protocol, & Multi-Lane Outbox

State changes and external side effects route through a unified, transactional method: `applyTransition`.

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│             applyTransition(event, actor, payload) CHOKE POINT        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1. Transaction Block: Execute inside this.ctx.storage.transaction()    │
│ 2. Evaluate FSM: Call evaluateTransition(currentState, event, actor)   │
│ 3. Apply Context Patch: Atomically update fsm_context in DO storage    │
│ 4. Selective Epoch Fencing:                                            │
│    • Revoking events (TIMEOUT, SECURITY, REJECT): Increment epoch.     │
│    • Promoting events (MERGE, ADVANCE): Retain epoch for valid writes. │
│ 5. Declarative Timer Management:                                       │
│    • Cancel invalid timers based on target state's active timer set.   │
│    • Arm new timers (e.g., watchdog on RUNNING, timeout on APPROVAL).  │
│ 6. Outbox Enqueue (Multi-Lane Partitioning):                           │
│    • Lane 1 (Projection): D1 attempt & task mirrors.                   │
│    • Lane 2 (Budget): Global spend settlement/release.                 │
│    • Lane 3 (GitHub): Sagas (close PR, delete ref) & merges.           │
│ 7. Trigger Outbox Drain: Schedule immediate async outbox flush.        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

```

#### Deterministic Priority-Queue Timer Scheduler

```typescript
// src/objects/TimerScheduler.ts
export type TimerType = 
  | 'WATCHDOG' 
  | 'BOOT_WATCHDOG' 
  | 'ABSOLUTE_CAP' 
  | 'APPROVAL_TIMEOUT' 
  | 'MERGE_TIMEOUT' 
  | 'ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT' 
  | 'OUTBOX_DRAIN';

export interface ScheduledTimer {
  type: TimerType;
  fireAt: number;
  epochScoped: boolean;
  epoch: number;
}

export class TimerScheduler {
  constructor(private storage: DurableObjectStorage) {}

  async schedule(timer: ScheduledTimer, txn?: DurableObjectTransaction): Promise<void> {
    const store = txn || this.storage;
    const timers = (await store.get<ScheduledTimer[]>('timers')) || [];
    const updated = timers.filter(t => t.type !== timer.type);
    updated.push(timer);
    updated.sort((a, b) => a.fireAt - b.fireAt);

    await store.put('timers', updated);
    await this.storage.setAlarm(updated[0].fireAt);
  }

  async cancel(type: TimerType, txn?: DurableObjectTransaction): Promise<void> {
    const store = txn || this.storage;
    const timers = (await store.get<ScheduledTimer[]>('timers')) || [];
    const updated = timers.filter(t => t.type !== type);
    await store.put('timers', updated);

    if (updated.length === 0) {
      await this.storage.deleteAlarm();
    } else {
      await this.storage.setAlarm(updated[0].fireAt);
    }
  }

  async cancelAllExcept(retainedTypes: TimerType[], txn?: DurableObjectTransaction): Promise<void> {
    const store = txn || this.storage;
    const timers = (await store.get<ScheduledTimer[]>('timers')) || [];
    const updated = timers.filter(t => retainedTypes.includes(t.type));
    await store.put('timers', updated);

    if (updated.length === 0) {
      await this.storage.deleteAlarm();
    } else {
      await this.storage.setAlarm(updated[0].fireAt);
    }
  }

  async pollDueTimers(currentEpoch: number): Promise<ScheduledTimer[]> {
    const now = Date.now();
    const timers = (await this.storage.get<ScheduledTimer[]>('timers')) || [];
    const due: ScheduledTimer[] = [];
    const remaining: ScheduledTimer[] = [];

    for (const t of timers) {
      if (t.fireAt <= now) {
        if (!t.epochScoped || t.epoch === currentEpoch) {
          due.push(t);
        }
      } else {
        remaining.push(t);
      }
    }

    await this.storage.put('timers', remaining);
    if (remaining.length > 0) {
      await this.storage.setAlarm(remaining[0].fireAt);
    } else {
      await this.storage.deleteAlarm();
    }

    return due;
  }
}

```

#### The `ShotCoordinator` Implementation (`src/objects/ShotCoordinator.ts`)

```typescript
import { DurableObject } from 'cloudflare:workers';
import { Env } from '../types';
import { TaskState, FSMEvent, AuthenticatedActor, FSMContext, evaluateTransition } from '../fsm/transitions';
import { TimerScheduler, TimerType } from './TimerScheduler';

export interface OutboxAction {
  id: string;
  lane: 'PROJECTION' | 'BUDGET' | 'GITHUB';
  type: 'D1_PROJECTION_UPDATE' | 'GLOBAL_BUDGET_SETTLE' | 'GITHUB_COMPENSATING_ACTIONS' | 'GITHUB_EXECUTE_MERGE';
  payload: Record<string, any>;
  attempts: number;
  deadLetter?: boolean;
}

export class ShotCoordinator extends DurableObject {
  private scheduler: TimerScheduler;

  constructor(ctx: DurableObjectState, env: Env) {
    super(ctx, env);
    this.scheduler = new TimerScheduler(this.ctx.storage);
  }

  async alarm(): Promise<void> {
    const epoch = (await this.ctx.storage.get<number>('epoch')) || 0;
    const dueTimers = await this.scheduler.pollDueTimers(epoch);

    for (const timer of dueTimers) {
      try {
        switch (timer.type) {
          case 'BOOT_WATCHDOG':
          case 'WATCHDOG':
            await this.applyTransition('WATCHDOG_EXPIRE', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
            break;
          case 'ABSOLUTE_CAP':
            await this.applyTransition('ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
            break;
          case 'APPROVAL_TIMEOUT':
            await this.applyTransition('APPROVAL_TIMEOUT', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
            break;
          case 'MERGE_TIMEOUT':
            await this.applyTransition('MERGE_TIMEOUT', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
            break;
          case 'ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT':
            await this.applyTransition('ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
            break;
          case 'OUTBOX_DRAIN':
            await this.drainOutbox();
            break;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.message && err.message.includes('ILLEGAL_FSM_TRANSITION')) {
          continue;
        }
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }

  async renewLease(workerEpoch: number): Promise<{ success: boolean; signal: 'CONTINUE' | 'HALT'; currentEpoch: number }> {
    const epoch = (await this.ctx.storage.get<number>('epoch')) || 0;
    const state = (await this.ctx.storage.get<TaskState>('fsm_state')) || 'PENDING';

    if (workerEpoch !== epoch || state !== 'RUNNING') {
      return { success: false, signal: 'HALT', currentEpoch: epoch };
    }

    // Interrogate GlobalCoordinator for kill switch / budget breaches
    const globalId = this.env.GLOBAL_COORDINATOR.idFromName('GLOBAL_SINGLETON');
    const globalCoord = this.env.GLOBAL_COORDINATOR.get(globalId);
    const systemStatus = await globalCoord.getSystemStatus();

    if (systemStatus.halted) {
      await this.applyTransition('KILL_SWITCH_TRIP', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
      return { success: false, signal: 'HALT', currentEpoch: epoch };
    }

    // Reset Watchdog Alarm by +30 seconds
    await this.scheduler.schedule({
      type: 'WATCHDOG',
      fireAt: Date.now() + 30000,
      epochScoped: true,
      epoch
    });

    return { success: true, signal: 'CONTINUE', currentEpoch: epoch };
  }

  async applyTransition(
    event: FSMEvent,
    actor: AuthenticatedActor,
    eventPayload?: any
  ): Promise<TaskState> {
    return await this.ctx.storage.transaction(async (txn) => {
      const currentState = (await txn.get<TaskState>('fsm_state')) || 'PENDING';
      let epoch = (await txn.get<number>('epoch')) || 0;
      let context = await txn.get<FSMContext>('fsm_context');

      if (!context) {
        throw new Error('CORRUPT_STATE_ERROR: fsm_context missing in Durable Object storage.');
      }

      // 1. Evaluate Transition Legality & Guards
      const result = evaluateTransition(currentState, event, actor, context, eventPayload);
      if (result.isNoop) {
        return currentState;
      }

      const nextState = result.nextState;

      // 2. Apply Atomic Context Patch
      if (result.contextPatch) {
        context = { ...context, ...result.contextPatch };
        await txn.put('fsm_context', context);
      }

      // 3. Selective Epoch Fencing
      const revokingEvents: FSMEvent[] = [
        'WATCHDOG_EXPIRE', 'ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT', 'SECURITY_VIOLATION', 
        'HUMAN_REJECT', 'APPROVAL_TIMEOUT', 'KILL_SWITCH_TRIP', 'WORKER_ABORT',
        'MERGE_TIMEOUT', 'ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT'
      ];
      if (revokingEvents.includes(event)) {
        epoch += 1;
        context.currentEpoch = epoch;
        await txn.put('epoch', epoch);
        await txn.put('fsm_context', context);
      }

      // 4. Declarative State Timer Lifecycle
      const ACTIVE_STATE_TIMERS: Record<TaskState, TimerType[]> = {
        PENDING: ['OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        CLAIMED: ['BOOT_WATCHDOG', 'OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        RUNNING: ['WATCHDOG', 'ABSOLUTE_CAP', 'OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        VERIFYING: ['ABSOLUTE_CAP', 'OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        SCOPE_PASSED: ['ABSOLUTE_CAP', 'OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        AWAITING_APPROVAL: ['APPROVAL_TIMEOUT', 'OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        MERGING: ['MERGE_TIMEOUT', 'OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        MERGED: [],
        RETRYING: ['OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        ROLLING_BACK: ['ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT', 'OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        ROLLED_BACK: ['OUTBOX_DRAIN'],
        DLQ: [],
        HALTED: []
      };

      await this.scheduler.cancelAllExcept(ACTIVE_STATE_TIMERS[nextState], txn);

      // Arm state entry timers
      if (nextState === 'CLAIMED') {
        await this.scheduler.schedule({
          type: 'BOOT_WATCHDOG',
          fireAt: Date.now() + 60000,
          epochScoped: true,
          epoch
        }, txn);
      } else if (nextState === 'RUNNING') {
        await this.scheduler.schedule({
          type: 'WATCHDOG',
          fireAt: Date.now() + 30000,
          epochScoped: true,
          epoch
        }, txn);
        await this.scheduler.schedule({
          type: 'ABSOLUTE_CAP',
          fireAt: Date.now() + 900000,
          epochScoped: true,
          epoch
        }, txn);
      } else if (nextState === 'AWAITING_APPROVAL') {
        await this.scheduler.schedule({
          type: 'APPROVAL_TIMEOUT',
          fireAt: Date.now() + 86400000,
          epochScoped: false,
          epoch
        }, txn);
      } else if (nextState === 'MERGING') {
        await this.scheduler.schedule({
          type: 'MERGE_TIMEOUT',
          fireAt: Date.now() + 120000, // 2-minute merge timeout
          epochScoped: false,
          epoch
        }, txn);
      } else if (nextState === 'ROLLING_BACK') {
        await this.scheduler.schedule({
          type: 'ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT',
          fireAt: Date.now() + 180000, // 3-minute rollback timeout
          epochScoped: false,
          epoch
        }, txn);
      }

      await txn.put('fsm_state', nextState);

      // 5. Multi-Lane Outbox Enqueue
      const outbox = (await txn.get<OutboxAction[]>('outbox')) || [];
      
      // Lane 1: D1 Read-Projection Mirror & Event Audit
      outbox.push({
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        lane: 'PROJECTION',
        type: 'D1_PROJECTION_UPDATE',
        payload: { 
          taskId: context.taskId, 
          state: nextState, 
          attempt: context.attemptCount, 
          branchName: context.branchName,
          baseCommitSha: context.baseCommitSha,
          headSha: context.candidateHeadSha,
          prNumber: context.prNumber,
          epoch, 
          reason: event, 
          diagnostic: eventPayload 
        },
        attempts: 0
      });

      // Lane 2: Global Budget Settlement
      if (['MERGED', 'DLQ', 'ROLLED_BACK'].includes(nextState)) {
        outbox.push({
          id: crypto.randomUUID(),
          lane: 'BUDGET',
          type: 'GLOBAL_BUDGET_SETTLE',
          payload: { 
            taskId: context.taskId, 
            state: nextState, 
            attempt: context.attemptCount,
            dedupeKey: `${context.taskId}:${context.attemptCount}` 
          },
          attempts: 0
        });
      }

      // Lane 3: Compensating GitHub Actions
      if (nextState === 'ROLLING_BACK') {
        outbox.push({
          id: crypto.randomUUID(),
          lane: 'GITHUB',
          type: 'GITHUB_COMPENSATING_ACTIONS',
          payload: { 
            taskId: context.taskId, 
            branchName: context.branchName, 
            prNumber: context.prNumber, 
            targetRepo: context.targetRepo, 
            reason: event 
          },
          attempts: 0
        });
      }

      // Lane 3: GitHub SHA-Pinned Merge Execution
      if (nextState === 'MERGING') {
        outbox.push({
          id: crypto.randomUUID(),
          lane: 'GITHUB',
          type: 'GITHUB_EXECUTE_MERGE',
          payload: {
            taskId: context.taskId,
            prNumber: context.prNumber,
            expectedSha: context.auditedHeadSha,
            targetRepo: context.targetRepo
          },
          attempts: 0
        });
      }

      await txn.put('outbox', outbox);

      // 6. Arm Outbox Drain Timer
      await this.scheduler.schedule({
        type: 'OUTBOX_DRAIN',
        fireAt: Date.now(),
        epochScoped: false,
        epoch
      }, txn);

      return nextState;
    });
  }

  private async drainOutbox(): Promise<void> {
    const actions = (await this.ctx.storage.get<OutboxAction[]>('outbox')) || [];
    if (actions.length === 0) return;

    // Process actions by independent lanes to prevent head-of-line blocking
    const lanes: Record<OutboxAction['lane'], OutboxAction[]> = {
      PROJECTION: actions.filter(a => a.lane === 'PROJECTION' && !a.deadLetter),
      BUDGET: actions.filter(a => a.lane === 'BUDGET' && !a.deadLetter),
      GITHUB: actions.filter(a => a.lane === 'GITHUB' && !a.deadLetter)
    };

    const remainingActions = [...actions];

    for (const laneKey of Object.keys(lanes) as Array<OutboxAction['lane']>) {
      for (const action of lanes[laneKey]) {
        try {
          await this.executeOutboxAction(action);
          // Remove completed action
          const idx = remainingActions.findIndex(a => a.id === action.id);
          if (idx !== -1) remainingActions.splice(idx, 1);
        } catch (err: any) {
          action.attempts += 1;
          if (action.attempts >= 5) {
            action.deadLetter = true;
          }
          // Break this lane only; allow other lanes to drain
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    await this.ctx.storage.put('outbox', remainingActions);

    if (remainingActions.some(a => !a.deadLetter)) {
      const epoch = (await this.ctx.storage.get<number>('epoch')) || 0;
      await this.scheduler.schedule({
        type: 'OUTBOX_DRAIN',
        fireAt: Date.now() + 5000, // 5s retry backoff
        epochScoped: false,
        epoch
      });
    }
  }

  private async executeOutboxAction(action: OutboxAction): Promise<void> {
    // Dispatches to D1, GlobalCoordinator, or GitHub App API
  }
}
```

### 4. Authoritative Server-Side Dispatch Contract

Clients submit identifiers and creative bounds; they do not dictate physical frame counts, geometry dimensions, or cost allocations. The server resolves physical truths against its ledger before generation begins.

```text
[ CLIENT REQUEST PAYLOAD ]
  • shot_id: "sh_101_04"
  • template_id: "WAN21_I2V_SURGICAL_INPAINT"
  • idempotency_key: UUID
  • payload_fingerprint: SHA-256
                              │
                              ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               SERVER-SIDE RESOLUTION & VERIFICATION                    │
│                                                                        │
│ • Canonical RFC 8785 JSON stringify -> verify payload_fingerprint      │
│ • Assert shot_id belongs to declared scene_id (reject pairing mismatch)│
│ • Pull audio duration from manifest: duration_ms = 3120ms              │
│ • Pull template config: native_fps = 16, lattice = 4n+1                │
│ • Pull background matte dimensions: canvas_width = 1280, height = 720  │
└─────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               DETERMINISTIC PARAMETER COMPILATION                      │
│                                                                        │
│ • raw_native_frames = ceil(3.120 * 16) = 50 frames                     │
│ • total_diffusion_allocation = 4 * ceil((50 - 1) / 4) + 1 = 53 frames  │
│ • Validate half-open frame range: 0 <= start < end <= 53               │
│ • Validate bounding box: 0 <= x1 < x2 <= 1280, 0 <= y1 < y2 <= 720     │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

```

#### Discriminated Task Contract (`src/schemas/dispatch.ts`)

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

const BaseDispatchFields = z.object({
  idempotency_key: z.string().uuid(),
  task_id: z.string().regex(/^TASK-[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{2})?$/),
  contract_version: z.enum(['v2.0.0', 'v2.1.0']),
  scene_id: z.string().min(1),
  shot_id: z.string().min(1),
  payload_fingerprint: z.string().length(64)
}).strict();

export const DispatchRequestSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('template_id', [
  BaseDispatchFields.extend({
    template_id: z.literal('WAN21_I2V_SURGICAL_INPAINT'),
    bounding_box: z.object({
      x1: z.number().int().min(0),
      y1: z.number().int().min(0),
      x2: z.number().int().min(0),
      y2: z.number().int().min(0)
    }),
    frame_range: z.object({
      start: z.number().int().min(0),
      end: z.number().int().min(0)
    })
  }),
  BaseDispatchFields.extend({
    template_id: z.literal('WAN21_T2V_BASE'),
    prompt_override: z.string().max(1000).optional()
  }),
  BaseDispatchFields.extend({
    template_id: z.literal('LIVE_PORTRAIT_HEAD'),
    anchor_id: z.string().min(1),
    driving_audio_stem: z.string().min(1)
  })
]);

export interface ResolvedServerFacts {
  scene_id: string;
  shot_id: string;
  duration_ms: number;
  native_fps: number;
  canvas_width: number;
  canvas_height: number;
  file_whitelist: string[];
  forbidden_patterns: string[];
}

export async function compileAndVerifyDispatch(
  rawInput: unknown,
  facts: ResolvedServerFacts
) {
  const parsed = DispatchRequestSchema.parse(rawInput);

  // 1. Cross-Field Ledger Authentication
  if (parsed.scene_id !== facts.scene_id) {
    throw new Error(`SECURITY_BREACH: Mismatched scene/shot pairing (${parsed.scene_id} !== ${facts.scene_id}).`);
  }

  // 2. Canonical JSON Fingerprint Verification (RFC 8785)
  const canonicalObj: Record<string, any> = {
    contract_version: parsed.contract_version,
    scene_id: parsed.scene_id,
    shot_id: parsed.shot_id,
    task_id: parsed.task_id,
    template_id: parsed.template_id
  };

  if (parsed.template_id === 'WAN21_I2V_SURGICAL_INPAINT') {
    canonicalObj.bounding_box = {
      x1: parsed.bounding_box.x1,
      x2: parsed.bounding_box.x2,
      y1: parsed.bounding_box.y1,
      y2: parsed.bounding_box.y2
    };
    canonicalObj.frame_range = {
      end: parsed.frame_range.end,
      start: parsed.frame_range.start
    };
  } else if (parsed.template_id === 'WAN21_T2V_BASE') {
    canonicalObj.prompt_override = parsed.prompt_override || '';
  } else if (parsed.template_id === 'LIVE_PORTRAIT_HEAD') {
    canonicalObj.anchor_id = parsed.anchor_id;
    canonicalObj.driving_audio_stem = parsed.driving_audio_stem;
  }

  const expectedFingerprint = await computeSha256(JSON.stringify(canonicalObj));
  if (parsed.payload_fingerprint !== expectedFingerprint) {
    throw new Error('FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: Payload does not match canonical fingerprint.');
  }

  // 3. Temporal Constraints & Lattice Allocation
  if (facts.duration_ms <= 0 || facts.duration_ms > 120000) {
    throw new Error(`PLAUSIBILITY_FAULT: Audio duration ${facts.duration_ms}ms outside bounds (0-120s).`);
  }
  const rawNativeFrames = Math.ceil((facts.duration_ms / 1000) * facts.native_fps);
  const requiredDiffusionFrames = 4 * Math.ceil((rawNativeFrames - 1) / 4) + 1;

  // 4. Template-Specific Bounding Assertions
  if (parsed.template_id === 'WAN21_I2V_SURGICAL_INPAINT') {
    const { bounding_box, frame_range } = parsed;

    if (bounding_box.x2 <= bounding_box.x1 || bounding_box.y2 <= bounding_box.y1) {
      throw new Error('GEOMETRIC_INVERSION: Bounding box coordinates inverted.');
    }
    if (bounding_box.x2 > facts.canvas_width || bounding_box.y2 > facts.canvas_height) {
      throw new Error(`BOUNDS_OVERFLOW: Coordinates exceed matte (${facts.canvas_width}x${facts.canvas_height}).`);
    }
    // Half-open temporal interval [start, end)
    if (frame_range.start >= frame_range.end) {
      throw new Error('TEMPORAL_INVERSION: frame_range.start must be strictly less than frame_range.end.');
    }
    if (frame_range.end > requiredDiffusionFrames) {
      throw new Error(`TEMPORAL_OVERFLOW: Frame end (${frame_range.end}) exceeds total allocation (${requiredDiffusionFrames}).`);
    }
  }

  return {
    ...parsed,
    server_derived_parameters: {
      duration_ms: facts.duration_ms,
      native_fps: facts.native_fps,
      total_diffusion_frames: requiredDiffusionFrames,
      file_whitelist: facts.file_whitelist,
      forbidden_patterns: facts.forbidden_patterns
    }
  };
}

async function computeSha256(data: string): Promise<string> {
  const msgUint8 = new TextEncoder().encode(data);
  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', msgUint8);
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}
```

### 5. Production DDL Schema & Relational Integrity

The relational schema normalizes current task status, isolates historical attempts, and bounds financial data across separate ledgers.

```sql
-- migrations/0001_init_repo_bot.sql

-- Transport Ingress Deduplication (Authoritative Edge Registry)
CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys (
  scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  delivery_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('RECEIVED', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED')) NOT NULL,
  handler_lease_expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  response_payload TEXT,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error TEXT,
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope, delivery_key)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_idempotency_lease ON idempotency_keys(status, handler_lease_expires_at_ms);

-- Immutable Task Specifications
CREATE TABLE tasks (
  task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  contract_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_repo TEXT NOT NULL,
  scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  shot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  current_attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  current_status TEXT CHECK(current_status IN (
    'PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'VERIFYING', 'SCOPE_PASSED',
    'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 'MERGING', 'MERGED', 'RETRYING', 
    'ROLLING_BACK', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'DLQ', 'HALTED'
  )) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  payload_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_whitelist_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  forbidden_patterns_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK(max_attempts >= 1),
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Historical Attempt Audit Trail (1:N)
CREATE TABLE task_attempts (
  attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_number >= 1),
  branch_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  base_commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  head_sha TEXT,
  pr_number INTEGER,
  last_projected_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN (
    'PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'RUNNING', 'VERIFYING', 'SCOPE_PASSED',
    'AWAITING_APPROVAL', 'MERGING', 'MERGED', 'RETRYING', 
    'ROLLING_BACK', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'DLQ', 'HALTED'
  )) NOT NULL,
  exit_reason TEXT,
  failure_diagnostic_json TEXT,
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
  UNIQUE(task_id, attempt_number)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_attempts_task_status ON task_attempts(task_id, status);
CREATE INDEX idx_attempts_branch ON task_attempts(branch_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_attempts_head_sha ON task_attempts(head_sha);

-- Append-Only System Audit Log
CREATE TABLE task_events (
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_state TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT,
  epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  diagnostic_json TEXT,
  emitted_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_task ON task_events(task_id, emitted_at_ms);

-- One-Shot Approval Ledger
CREATE TABLE approvals (
  approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  decided_by TEXT,
  decision TEXT CHECK(decision IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'TIMEOUT')),
  decided_at_ms INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
  UNIQUE(task_id, head_sha)
);

-- System Flags & Kill Switches
CREATE TABLE system_flags (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- Stratified Operational Cost Telemetry
CREATE TABLE operational_telemetry (
  telemetry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  contract_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  manifest_id TEXT,
  shot_class TEXT CHECK(shot_class IN ('CLOSE_UP', 'MEDIUM_SHOT', 'WIDE_ESTABLISHING', 'SURGICAL_INPAINT')) NOT NULL,
  resolution TEXT CHECK(resolution IN ('720P', '1080P', '4K')) NOT NULL,
  compute_tier TEXT CHECK(compute_tier IN ('LOCAL_RIG2', 'SERVERLESS_RUNPOD', 'CPU_SPECIALIST')) NOT NULL,
  tokens_consumed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  gpu_seconds REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
  cap_charged_usd REAL NOT NULL CHECK(cap_charged_usd >= 0.0),
  estimated_actual_usd REAL NOT NULL CHECK(estimated_actual_usd >= 0.0),
  terminal_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  executed_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_telemetry_stratified ON operational_telemetry(shot_class, resolution, compute_tier);

-- Shadow Mode Violation Analysis
CREATE TABLE shadow_violations (
  violation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  rule_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  rule_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  violating_span TEXT NOT NULL,
  hypothetical_action TEXT CHECK(hypothetical_action IN ('WOULD_ROLLBACK', 'WOULD_BLOCK_MERGE')) NOT NULL,
  human_disposition TEXT CHECK(human_disposition IN ('UNREVIEWED', 'TRUE_POSITIVE', 'FALSE_POSITIVE', 'AMBIGUOUS')) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNREVIEWED',
  reviewed_by TEXT,
  reviewed_at_ms INTEGER,
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(task_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_shadow_disposition ON shadow_violations(human_disposition);
```

### 6. The Quality Gauntlet, SHA-Pinned Merge, & Scheduled Daemons

#### Quality Result Ingestion Handler (`src/routes/githubQualityResult.ts`)

```typescript
export async function handleCheckRunEvent(env: Env, payload: any): Promise<void> {
  if (payload.check_run.name !== 'repo-bot/quality-gauntlet') return;
  if (payload.action !== 'completed') return;

  const headBranch = payload.check_run.check_suite.head_branch;
  const headSha = payload.check_run.head_sha;
  const conclusion = payload.check_run.conclusion; // 'success' | 'failure'

  // Extract task ID deterministically from branch name (e.g. spec/task-04.01-attempt1-c7f490)
  const taskMatch = headBranch.match(/^spec\/(task-[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{2})?)-/i);
  if (!taskMatch) return;

  const taskId = taskMatch[1].toUpperCase();
  const coordId = env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.idFromName(taskId);
  const coordinator = env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.get(coordId);

  if (conclusion === 'success') {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('QUALITY_PASS', { type: 'AUDIT_ENGINE' }, { headSha });
  } else {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('QUALITY_FAIL_RETRY', { type: 'AUDIT_ENGINE' }, {
      headSha,
      diagnostic: 'Test suite assertion failure or invariant linter exit != 0'
    });
  }
}

```

#### Idempotent SHA-Pinned Merge Execution (`src/services/mergeService.ts`)

```typescript
export async function executeShaPinnedMerge(env: Env, payload: {
  taskId: string;
  prNumber: number;
  expectedSha: string;
  targetRepo: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const octokit = new Octokit({ auth: await getInstallationToken(env, 'studio-owner', payload.targetRepo) });
  const coordId = env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.idFromName(payload.taskId);
  const coordinator = env.SHOT_COORDINATOR.get(coordId);

  // 1. Check if PR was already merged with matching SHA
  const pr = await octokit.pulls.get({
    owner: 'studio-owner',
    repo: payload.targetRepo,
    pull_number: payload.prNumber
  });

  if (pr.data.merged) {
    if (pr.data.merge_commit_sha) {
      await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_SUCCEEDED', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
      return;
    }
  }

  // 2. Lineage Verification: Verify head has not moved
  if (pr.data.head.sha !== payload.expectedSha) {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_FAILED_HEAD_MOVED', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, {
      error: `HEAD_MOVED: Expected ${payload.expectedSha}, found ${pr.data.head.sha}`
    });
    return;
  }

  // 3. Fetch check runs and resolve LATEST status per name
  const checkRuns = await octokit.paginate(octokit.checks.listForRef, {
    owner: 'studio-owner',
    repo: payload.targetRepo,
    ref: payload.expectedSha
  });

  const latestRuns = new Map<string, { conclusion: string; completed_at: string }>();
  for (const run of checkRuns) {
    const existing = latestRuns.get(run.name);
    if (!existing || new Date(run.completed_at!).getTime() > new Date(existing.completed_at).getTime()) {
      latestRuns.set(run.name, { conclusion: run.conclusion!, completed_at: run.completed_at! });
    }
  }

  const scopeOk = latestRuns.get('repo-bot/scope-check')?.conclusion === 'success';
  const qualityOk = latestRuns.get('repo-bot/quality-gauntlet')?.conclusion === 'success';

  if (!scopeOk || !qualityOk) {
    await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_FAILED_CONFLICT', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, {
      error: 'PRECONDITION_FAILED: Required check runs not green for target SHA.'
    });
    return;
  }

  // 4. Execute SHA-pinned squash merge
  try {
    await octokit.pulls.merge({
      owner: 'studio-owner',
      repo: payload.targetRepo,
      pull_number: payload.prNumber,
      sha: payload.expectedSha,
      merge_method: 'squash'
    });
    await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_SUCCEEDED', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' });
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err.status === 409) {
      await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_FAILED_CONFLICT', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, { error: err.message });
    } else {
      await coordinator.applyTransition('MERGE_FAILED_TRANSIENT', { type: 'SYSTEM_INTERNAL' }, { error: err.message });
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
export default {
  fetch: app.fetch,
  async scheduled(event: ScheduledEvent, env: Env, ctx: ExecutionContext): Promise<void> {
    switch (event.cron) {
      case '0 * * * *': // Hourly: Drift Reconciliation & Expired Transport Reclaim
        ctx.waitUntil(runHourlyReconciliation(env));
        break;
      case '0 3 * * *': // Daily 03:00 UTC: Branch, Staging R2 & Idempotency Prune
        ctx.waitUntil(runDailyGarbageCollection(env));
        break;
      case '0 9 * * *': // Daily 09:00 UTC: Repo Dormancy Accountability Audit
        ctx.waitUntil(runAccountabilityAudit(env));
        break;
      case '0 4 1 * *': // Monthly 1st @ 04:00 UTC: RunPod Hardware Canary
        ctx.waitUntil(triggerMonthlyCanary(env));
        break;
      case '0 0 * * *': // Daily 00:00 UTC: Rolling Archive Cursor Scrub
        ctx.waitUntil(runRollingArchiveScrub(env));
        break;
    }
  }
};
```
